"— Nous n’avons qu’une femme pour vous aider. Chacun fait ce qu’il peut. Parce que dom Mabillon donne quatre cent dix-sept épîtres de saint Bernard et que Merlonus Horstius n’en donne que trois cent soixante-sept, je ne méprise point Merlonus Horstius.", "sha256": "b7f9d5db185630cf4eb5fe7159adcf61b2fa56fa71a9394e72cfec62b482cb81", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0018", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ni moi non plus.", "sha256": "ed2a220637575ce6477eeafe73aff7d0db531d5afff2fca3e7bb6d9470a19fea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0019", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le mérite est de travailler selon ses forces. C’est mon frère qui est fort !", "sha256": "8ecb3ab827e536debf4ab5fee1926aea6c31c103f66579c6f36c0b9cb0a49ec9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0021", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et puis vous aurez un levier.", "sha256": "5a14bf6b503c03ad785781fa41d8e6a82234cfc2e793a3e44ea9b3dc2ea1913f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0022", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est la seule espèce de clef qui aille à ces espèces de portes.", "sha256": "ba918f894ce68738053361545432062a5bf9301f72b8928561bbd0e93a8d7d0a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0023", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il y a un anneau à la pierre.", "sha256": "7a61abb9de30171d98ea0629548715c3c6142686deabcf6c26450d27d6ce3488", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0024", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’y passerai le levier.", "sha256": "cfe09f76e6c8e2762c6adc00a89e666e7da1a5477c07172203af98c744feca5f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0025", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et la pierre est arrangée de façon à pivoter.", "sha256": "2ac6c51fda11473524a156da1a925575834c165292097093231fe52a3b087e6c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0026", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est bien, révérende mère. J’ouvrirai le caveau.", "sha256": "e0c6f4bc29ab9625db1d3a69873a525b9234a75f4deebbbaa337bda2de164733", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0027", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et les quatre mères chantres vous assisteront.", "sha256": "e004d729fbf5e04777568b7ba5f4b9dc817b173492822841331db4239e834834", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0028", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et quand le caveau sera ouvert ?", "sha256": "9013356f3558368667a44db1fe3d4d2b62846136d652d601e31ec8787497524b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0029", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il faudra le refermer.", "sha256": "e9787c5cfdfbc762ed66530e33bd95a22faeb595564b357c9ca5f2fe1611e6cc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0030", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sera-ce tout ?", "sha256": "e45efba26400cacba76b7d56dcb543ff61651be10132ef2d5d833f5c33915caf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non.", "sha256": "ac641d7ffd6b132ddcd7d7944dc3ccc96acf3113cab60712c9516858cbfdaab2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
